test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ids (l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_linenumber Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_shipdate Date) ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = 'iceberg_deletes_scale_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/')
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ids SELECT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate FROM tpch10.lineitem ORDER BY l_orderkey, l_linenumber SETTINGS iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 1000000, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 65409
DELETE FROM ids WHERE l_orderkey >= ({a} * 20 + {b}) * 200000 AND l_orderkey < ({a} * 20 + {b}) * 200000 + 200

CREATE TABLE ids_1pct ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = (SELECT extract(_path, 'iceberg_deletes_scale_[0-9]+/') FROM ids LIMIT 1)) SETTINGS iceberg_metadata_file_path = 'metadata/v3.metadata.json'

CREATE TABLE ids_10pct ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = (SELECT extract(_path, 'iceberg_deletes_scale_[0-9]+/') FROM ids LIMIT 1)) SETTINGS iceberg_metadata_file_path = 'metadata/v4.metadata.json'
SELECT throwIf(count() != 303) FROM system.iceberg_history WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'ids'
SELECT throwIf(countIf(content = 0) != 58 OR countIf(content = 1) != 302) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'ids'
SELECT throwIf(countIf(content = 1) != 2) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'ids_10pct'

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count() FROM ids_1pct) != countIf(l_orderkey % 100 != 1) OR (SELECT count() FROM ids_10pct) != countIf(l_orderkey % 10 != 1) OR (SELECT count() FROM ids) != countIf(l_orderkey % 10 != 1 AND NOT (intDiv(l_orderkey, 200000) < 300 AND l_orderkey % 200000 < 200))) FROM tpch10.lineitem

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(l_quantity)) != (SELECT countIf(l_orderkey % 100 != 1), sumIf(toFloat64(l_quantity), l_orderkey % 100 != 1) FROM tpch10.lineitem)) FROM ids_1pct SETTINGS use_roaring_bitmap_iceberg_positional_deletes = {roaring}

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(l_quantity)) != (SELECT countIf(l_orderkey % 10 != 1), sumIf(toFloat64(l_quantity), l_orderkey % 10 != 1) FROM tpch10.lineitem)) FROM ids_10pct SETTINGS use_roaring_bitmap_iceberg_positional_deletes = {roaring}

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(l_quantity)) != (SELECT countIf(c), sumIf(toFloat64(l_quantity), c) FROM (SELECT l_quantity, l_orderkey % 10 != 1 AND NOT (intDiv(l_orderkey, 200000) < 300 AND l_orderkey % 200000 < 200) AS c FROM tpch10.lineitem))) FROM ids SETTINGS use_roaring_bitmap_iceberg_positional_deletes = {roaring}

test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ids_1pct, ids_10pct, ids SYNC
